title: Purple Hammer Warrior
description: A confident female warrior with long dark hair in a topknot stands in a dynamic pose against a solid gray background. She wears tribal-style orange and purple armor with geometric patterns, holds a massive ornate purple warhammer in her right hand, and points forward with her left index finger while smirking.
prompt: A fierce young woman with long dark hair tied in a topknot with bone ornaments, wearing orange cropped tribal armor with geometric tattoos on her arms, purple and orange patterned pants, and purple boots.
